reasons.text: מתחת לממוצע 200 יום, ממוצע 50 מתחת לממוצע 200 (מגמה יורדת ארוכה), מתחת לממוצע 50 יום, ⁦-46%⁩ ב-3 חודשים

about: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., a technology company, provides technology, hardware, products, system, and software for the defense, national security, and commercial markets in the United States, other North America, the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Europe, and Internationally. The company operates through Kratos Government Solutions and Unmanned Systems segments. It offers virtualized ground systems for satellites and space vehicles, including software for command and control, telemetry, and tracking and control; jet powered unmanned aerial drone systems and hypersonic vehicles
